activities.label: ATP and energy transfer
activities.title: ATP in your own words
activities.body: Read the explanation, then answer the next question from memory.

essentialIdeas: ATP stores and transfers usable energy for cellular work by losing a phosphate group, which makes energy available to the cell.

activities.label: Explain ATP in your own words
activities.title: Explain ATP in your own words
activities.body: Write a short explanation from memory.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP stores usable energy and transfers it when it loses a phosphate group.
activities.feedback: A complete answer says ATP is a usable energy carrier, not just an energy source, and mentions phosphate loss as the transfer step.

activities.label: Fix the energy idea
activities.title: Fix the energy idea
choices: ATP transfers usable energy by losing a phosphate group.
ATP makes energy from nothing inside the cell.
ATP keeps energy permanently without changing.
ATP only stores energy and never releases it.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP transfers usable energy by losing a phosphate group.
activities.feedback: ATP is an energy carrier. It releases usable energy through phosphate loss, rather than creating energy or holding it unchanged.

activities.label: ATP explanation again
activities.title: ATP explanation again
activities.body: Explain it again in your own words.
activities.correctAnswer: ATP stores usable energy and transfers it when it loses a phosphate group, helping power cellular work.
activities.feedback: Your answer should clearly state the transfer role of ATP and the phosphate change.
